'''Tex Vandale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] executive on the board of [[Tapani Starship Cooperative]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the war he sympathized with the Alliance and gave Rebel Cells in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] access to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] made by the cooperative. He was willing to sell ships to the Alliance through fake accounts, but only if absolutely convinced that it was safe.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tex Vandale first appeared as a possible ally for Rebel heroes in the campaign guide included in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The supplement was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and did not clarify Vandale's [[Species/Legends|species]].
